This competition takes place on a **Thursday Evening** and will only feature 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and Megaminx. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
